key_insight: Symbal detects recurring captioning errors in multimodal models by linking a specific mistake to a specific visual feature, enabling systematic audit of image-text misalignment.
clinical_relevance: In clinical imaging workflows, this could help flag unreliable model-generated captions or reports before they are used for documentation, indexing, or downstream decision-making.
method: Uses a dual-stage pipeline with off-the-shelf foundation models.
First identifies whether a systematic misalignment is present, then summarizes the error in natural language.
Designed to work without access to the underlying captioning model.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on SymbalBench with 1.7 million image-text pairs across 420 datasets from natural and medical domains, where Symbal correctly identified systematic misalignments in 63.8% of datasets, about 4x better than the nearest baseline.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-dependent, so real-world deployment may still miss subtle or rare errors and should be paired with human review.
paper_title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
